fusions.name: Arc Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of raw arcana into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 damage. It also costs 5% of your maximum health. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Shockwave Step
fusions.desc: Releases a pulse of arcana that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Slip Through
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and your dodge chance rises by 10% for the move.

fusions.name: Second Source
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 4 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
